> Clean by construction: an internal decision memo. Near-miss for the vague
> declarative family — "two things changed" names both things immediately.

Two things changed this week that affect the Q3 plan. The vendor moved their
API deprecation from October to July, and the second engineer on the team goes
on leave in August.

Either alone is absorbable. Together they mean the integration rewrite has to
start in May or slip past the deprecation, and slipping past it means paying
for the legacy endpoint at four times the current rate.

I am proposing we start in May and drop the reporting refresh. That is the
trade I would rather make, and I would like to hear the argument for the other
one before Friday.
